objective: Diagnostico aislado READ_ONLY de la consulta KEYS del Gate3B Custodia. No DDL/DML, no cambios de repositorio, no Produccion.

queries.name: keys
queries.sql: SELECT s.name AS schema_name,t.name AS table_name,c.name AS column_name,kc.name AS key_constraint,kc.type_desc FROM sys.tables t JOIN sys.schemas s ON s.schema_id=t.schema_id JOIN sys.index_columns ic ON ic.object_id=t.object_id JOIN sys.columns c ON c.object_id=t.object_id AND c.column_id=ic.column_id JOIN sys.indexes i ON i.object_id=t.object_id AND i.index_id=ic.index_id LEFT JOIN sys.key_constraints kc ON kc.parent_object_id=t.object_id AND kc.unique_index_id=i.index_id WHERE s.name='dbo' AND i.is_unique=1 AND ((t.name='RH_Colaboradores_Expediente' AND c.name='ColaboradorID') OR (t.name='RH_Cat_Puestos' AND c.name='PuestoID') OR (t.name='Producto_Catalogo' AND c.name='ProductoID') OR (t.name='ActivoFijo_Activos' AND c.name='ActivoID') OR (t.name='Sistema_Empresas' AND c.name='EmpresaID') OR (t.name='Unidades_Negocio' AND c.name='id') OR (t.name='Sistema_Sucursales' AND c.name='SucursalID') OR (t.name='Usuario_Catalogo' AND c.name='UsuarioID') OR (t.name='Gobierno_Documento' AND c.name='DocumentoID') OR (t.name='RH_Nomina_Detalle' AND c.name='NominaDetalleID')) ORDER BY t.name,c.name;
